The d active barycentric coordinates determine the unique vertex of the same type. No remaining generator can have base p. Conversely these same vertices and weights reconstruct the mark in every incident facet hull. The argument also covers an interval endpoint and a single sampled base.

For an arbitrary convex C, each intermediate fiber on the selected hull is nonempty. Its infimum is bounded above by interpolation from sampled fibers. A -infinite infimum would force the finite value at p to be -infinite by the decomposition p=epsilon*y+(1-epsilon)*y_prime. Both inequalities therefore have finite values and force affine interpolation on the entire common hull.
